V. 11.
To you, who have, it is given to k••w the myſt••ies of the kingdom of •e•ven—The deep Things, which Fleſh and Blood cannot reveal, pertaining to the inward, preſent Kingdom of Heaven. But to •••m who have not, it is not given—Therefore ſpeak I i• parables, that ye may underſtand, while they do not underſtand
